card.name: Word completing a set medical phrase
card.fires_on: The word that finishes a familiar phrase, mostly "access" after "expanded", "less" or "need for", and "istic" in "naturalistic". It also fires on a few similar completers such as "England", "first" and "receipt".

modes.label: Other phrase completers
modes.description: Single words that finish a study or place phrase, such as "England", "first" and "receipt".
